offers.sn: To meet our current corporate needs, we would like to bring to our team a Software Engineering Architect. As our new Software Engineering Architect you will undertake tasks, such as:
offers.rq: University Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering or relevant technology field. At least 7 years of total relevant working experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior engineering or architect position. - Cloud Native architecture (such as Microsoft Azure/AWS) Excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken.
